from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==0 for r in range(h)) and c>0 and c<w-1]
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==0 for v in grid[r]) and r>0 and r<h-1]
    if cols:
        c=cols[len(cols)//2]
        parts=[[row[:c] for row in grid],[row[c+1:] for row in grid]]
    elif rows:
        r=rows[len(rows)//2];parts=[grid[:r],grid[r+1:]]
    else:return [[0]]
    def extract(g):
        bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
        if not pts:return [[0]],[[0]]
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts);r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts);c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        out=[[g[r][c] if g[r][c]!=bg else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        mask=[[int(g[r][c]!=bg) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        return out,mask
    a,am=extract(parts[0]);b,bm=extract(parts[1])
    return a if am==bm else [[0]]
